summary: Recent updates to the WebRTC web API significantly enhance how developers can manage network connections for real-time communication. The implementation of the **RTCIceTransport selected candidate pair API** allows for improved monitoring and control over which network candidates are being used during a peer connection, which can lead to better performance in video calls and other interactive applications. Additionally, by enabling the reporting of outbound RTP (Real-time Transport Protocol) statistics, developers can now gain insights into data being sent across the connection, facilitating more effective troubleshooting and optimization. This is crucial for maintaining high-quality connections in applications relying on WebRTC, such as video conferencing tools.
